name: nylon_guitar
description: Plucked-string nylon interpretation with a rounded attack, evolving string loss and gentle low-mid body weighting.

guidance.pitch_behavior: Note pitch tracks the plucked string. bend_ratio and 5 Hz additive vibrato preserve string history.
guidance.notes: Synthesized string model with broad filter body weighting, not recorded audio or a complete soundbox. Natural decay and note-off release are separate. All E2–E6 semitones rendered; E2/E6 also checked with combined +/-2-semitone bend and full vibrato. Four-second gates and overlapping chords checked. Recommended bend_ratio is 0.890899..1.122462 and vibrato_amount 0..1. Velocity scales amplitude, not excitation timbre. Numerical validation does not constitute listening approval.
